independent_contract: A generic literal pair is input.map some ++ [none] ++ cert.map some over Option Bool. The delimiter is one present source symbol. It is never erased, encoded by an arbitrary word map, or confused with physical tape blank.

A checking relation R : List Bool -> List Bool -> Prop carries one actual ConventionalPolynomialDraft150.PolynomialDecider over Option Bool, with its Boolean specification fixed, and arbitrary-raw accepted-language iff raw is exactly a literal pair with R input cert. The machine is fixed before raw.

A ConventionalVerifierCriterion L fixes R, that actual checking-relation machine, and one natural witness exponent k BEFORE every input. Its correctness is L input iff exists cert with cert.length <= input.length^k and R input cert. No additive constant appears in the certificate bound.

The generic owner imports the generic conventional contract and basic list mathematics, never RotationCertificate. Pair uniqueness should follow from existing Mathlib list/symbol facts, without another parser.
